attributes.description:
Sets the background color of each list row. This is the main background color for list item content.
CSS variable: --wm-list-template-background-color

Controls the padding inside each list row. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-list-template-padding

Controls the corner rounding of each list row.
CSS variable: --wm-list-template-border-radius

Sets the border color of each list row.
CSS variable: --wm-list-template-border-color

Controls the border thickness of each list row.
CSS variable: --wm-list-template-border-width

Controls the border style of each list row.
CSS variable: --wm-list-template-border-style

Minimum height of each list row.
CSS variable: --wm-list-template-min-height

Controls the shadow of each list row.
CSS variable: --wm-list-template-box-shadow

Sets the background color of list (boxes that hold content). This is the main background color that appears behind all list content.
CSS variable: --wm-list-background-color

Controls the style of the outline around list container 'solid' creates a continuous line, 'dashed' creates a dotted line, 'dotted' creates small dots.
CSS variable: --wm-list-border-style

Controls the thickness of the border around list. When set to 0, there's no visible border. Higher values create thicker borders around the container.
CSS variable: --wm-list-border-width

Sets the color of the border around list. This creates a colored border around the list to define its boundaries.
CSS variable: --wm-list-border-color

Controls the corner rounding of the list. When set to 'none', containers have sharp corners. Higher values create more rounded corners for a softer appearance.
CSS variable: --wm-list-border-radius
